VirtualTable

A data grid for very long lists: only the rows in view (plus overscan) are in the DOM, so 100 000 rows scroll as smoothly as 100. Sorting, resizing, hiding columns, inline editing, selection and keyboard navigation are built in; everything is controlled or uncontrolled.

Source src/react/data/VirtualTable.tsx See it in the gallery

tsx 
import { VirtualTable } from "@osqd/ui"; const rows = Array.from({ length: 100_000 }, (_, i) => ({  id: i + 1,  host: `node-${i + 1}`,  rps: (i * 7919) % 5000,}));return (  <VirtualTable    height={260}    rows={rows}    columns={[      { key: "id", header: "#", width: 90, align: "right" },      { key: "host", header: "Host", width: 200, mono: true },      { key: "rps", header: "Req/s", width: 120, align: "right", editable: true },    ]}  />);

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
columnsrequired Array<VirtualColumn<Row>> — —
rowsrequired readonly Row[] — —
rowKey (row: Row, index: number) => Key — Stable row key; defaults to row.id, then the index in rows.
rowHeight number — Row height in px; every row is the same height, which is what makes windowing cheap.
height number 420 Height of the scrolling area in px. Default 420.
overscan number 8 —
dense boolean — —
striped boolean — —
stickyFirstColumn boolean — Keep the first data column in view while scrolling sideways.
sort SortState | null — —
defaultSort SortState | null null —
onSortChange (sort: SortState | null) => void — —
selectable boolean — —
selected Key[] — —
onSelectedChange (keys: Key[]) => void — —
hiddenColumns string[] — —
defaultHiddenColumns string[] [] —
onHiddenColumnsChange (keys: string[]) => void — —
columnWidths Record<string, number> — —
onColumnResize (key: string, width: number) => void — —
onCellEdit (row: Row, key: string, value: string, rowIndex: number) => void — —
onRowActivate (row: Row, rowIndex: number) => void — Enter on a row with no editable cell under the cursor, or a double-click on a plain cell.
toolbar ReactNode — Extra controls at the left of the toolbar.
columnMenu boolean — Show the columns menu in the toolbar. Default true when any column is hideable.
exportCsv boolean | string — Show an "Export CSV" button; a string sets the file name.
empty ReactNode "No rows" —

Also accepts every native <div> attribute, passed through to the root element.
